title: Profile
description: The intake record written at Checkpoint A (profile.json). Required fields must never be guessed or defaulted silently — they are asked. Recommended fields may be defaulted, but every default used must also appear in 'assumptions'.

goods_and_services.description: Concrete, free-text description of what the name will be used for. Never inferred — this is what decides whether a conflicting mark actually collides (rule #4).

target_territories.description: E.g. ['DE', 'EU']. Never inferred — always asked, default DE+EU offered but must be confirmed.

prior_events.description: The Checkpoint A question that no search can answer for the user (four of the §11 hard stops live only here).

sector_modules_applicable.description: Module names identified as potentially relevant during Phase 8 triage (e.g. ['finance', 'healthcare']). Every name here must end up either as a 'sector-<name>' cluster's findings or an entry in sector_modules_not_applicable — the special_sector_rules_checked gate checks exactly this.

sector_modules_not_applicable.description: For each §8 special-sector module not triggered by this name/industry, a reason it was excluded. Read by the special_sector_rules_checked gate.

assumptions.description: Rule #9: every assumption must be flagged as an assumption. Any recommended-field default that was used without explicit user confirmation goes here.
